The [entropy](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/expectation.html#def-entropy) of a [random variable](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/random-variables.html#def-random-variable) averages its [surprisal](entropy.qmd#def-surprisal).
Other summaries of its [probabilities](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-probability) answer other questions.
This page adds the smallest of them, the [min-entropy](#def-min-entropy),
to the [collision entropy](entropy.qmd#def-renyi-entropy).
